decisions.choice: a bare list of names: each man the father of the next
decisions.reason: Verses 1-4 have no verbs and no words for "son" or "fathered". They give only the names of Genesis 5:3-32, from Adam to Noah, without the ages. Readers who knew Genesis would hear each name as the father of the one after it. The book opens its history of Israel with the first man.

decisions.choice: names joined by commas, one running list through verse 4
alternatives: Adam was the father of Seth, and Seth was the father of Enosh
decisions.reason: Every level keeps the list as the Hebrew gives it, without adding "was the father of", so the bare form of the opening can be seen.

decisions.choice: Names of Genesis in the forms of the published Spanish Genesis ("Enós", "Cainán", "Mahalaleel", "Arfaxad", "Sala", "Nacor", "Taré")
decisions.reason: Chronicles 1 repeats the names of Genesis 5, 10, 11, 25 and 36; Spanish keeps the forms its Genesis already publishes, and changes a name only where the Hebrew of Chronicles spells it differently (Difat, Rodanim, Ebal, Zefi, Alián, Sefi, Hamrán, Jaacán, Pai), as the English does.

decisions.choice: names in the forms of the French Genesis (Énosh, Kénan, Mahalaleel, Hénoch, Mathusalem, Noé, Sem, Cham, Japhet, Koush, Héber, Péleg, Ketoura, Ésaü...); a name with no published French form transcribes the Hebrew as the Samuel and Kings drafts do (y for yod, ts, q, ou, sh: Yerahmeel, Yaïr)
decisions.reason: For 1 Chronicles 1-10: Chronicles repeats the names of Genesis 5, 10, 11, 25, 36 and 46, Exodus 6 and Numbers 1, so a reader must meet the same French spelling here as there. Published forms win (French style guide); other names follow one transcription, kept the same through all four books.

decisions.choice: names in the Swahili forms of Genesis 5 and 10
decisions.reason: The genealogies of 1 Chronicles 1-9 use the names as the Swahili Genesis, Exodus and Numbers already spell them (Adamu, Sethi, Enoshi, Nuhu, Yafethi); a name not found there follows the usual Swahili form, ending in a vowel, and is used the same way through 1 Chronicles 1-9.

decisions.choice: names in the forms of the Vietnamese Genesis: A-đam, Sết, Ê-nót, Cai-nan, Ma-ha-la-le-ên ...
decisions.reason: 1 Chronicles 1 repeats the lists of Genesis 5, 10, 11, 25 and 36, so every name keeps the form the Vietnamese Genesis already uses (Kenan is "Cai-nan" as in Genesis 5), and a name new to Chronicles follows the same Protestant transliteration.

decisions.choice: the bare list of names kept, without "낳았다"
decisions.reason: As the English, every level keeps the Hebrew's verbless list through verse 4. The names are those of the Korean Genesis 5 (아담, 셋, 에노스, 게난, 마할랄렐, 야렛, 에녹, 므두셀라, 라멕, 노아).

decisions.choice: Adão, Sete, Enos ... Noé: the name forms of Genesis 5 in Portuguese
decisions.reason: For the whole of 1 Chronicles 1-9: every name with a parallel takes the Portuguese form already used in Genesis (Adão, Sete, Enos, Cainã, Maalalel, Jarede, Enoque, Matusalém, Lameque, Noé), Ruth, Samuel and Kings, so that a reader meets the same person under the same name. The bare list is kept at every level, as the English keeps it (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "አዳም፣ ሴት፣ ሄኖስ": the name forms of the Amharic Genesis 5
decisions.reason: For 1 Chronicles 1-2 every name with a parallel keeps the Amharic form already used in Genesis, Numbers, Joshua, Ruth and Samuel (Genesis 5: አዳም, ሴት, ሄኖስ, ቃይናን, መላልኤል, ያሬድ, ሄኖክ, ማቱሳላ, ላሜሕ, ኖኅ), so that a reader meets the same person under the same name. Where the Chronicles Hebrew spells a name differently, the Amharic follows the Hebrew and a decision names the Genesis form.

decisions.choice: names in their Genesis forms: Адам, Сиф, Енос, Каинан, Малелеил, Иаред, Енох, Мафусал, Ламех, Ной
alternatives: a fresh transcription of the Hebrew (Кенан, Махалалел)
decisions.reason: Chronicles copies Genesis 5 here; the names keep the forms Genesis and Luke 3 use in this translation, so the reader recognises the same line.

decisions.choice: Os filhos de X: A e B e C (L); Os filhos de X: A, B e C (B); Os filhos de X foram A, B e C (R)

decisions.reason: For the whole of 1 Chronicles 1-9: one list formula per level, as the English (r-en-1). Literal keeps every "e" of the Hebrew and needs no bracket for "Os", which Portuguese requires, as Genesis 10:2 writes it; Balanced keeps the colon; Readable makes a sentence with "foram". Readable does not say "de Jafé os filhos" or "Jafé teve como filhos": "Os filhos de X foram" is the plain Brazilian form and the one Genesis 10 uses.

decisions.choice: list formula: L "የX ልጆች A፣ B[ና] C [ናቸው]", B and R "የX ልጆች ... ነበሩ"

decisions.reason: Verses 5-9 and 17 keep the Amharic of Genesis 10:2-7, 22 at Literal and Balanced. The same formula is used for every "the sons of X:" list in chapters 1-2, so Readable drops the "ወንዶች" that Genesis 10 adds at that level (Genesis 36 and 46 have none); the Hebrew word is the same throughout. alternatives: "X के पुत्र A, B और C थे" at Balanced, as Genesis 10:2
decisions.reason: One list formula per level through the genealogies of 1 Chronicles 1-9. Literal keeps each "and" of the Hebrew, Balanced keeps the bare list with a colon as the English does, and Readable makes a sentence with the everyday "बेटे", as Genesis 10 does at Readable. decisions.choice: Genesis 10:8, without the story that follows
decisions.reason: The verse is Genesis 10:8 word for word, and "mighty man" means a warrior, a man of power, as there. Chronicles leaves out what Genesis 10:9-12 tells of Nimrod as a hunter and of his kingdom in Babylonia and Assyria.

decisions.choice: begot (Literal); was the father of (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The active verb "fathered" in the genealogies is "begot" at Literal and "was the father of" at Balanced and Readable throughout 1 Chronicles 1-9. Where the names are peoples (verse 11) it means "was the ancestor of".

decisions.choice: "engendró a" (L); "fue padre de" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb "fathered" keeps one wording through 1 Chronicles 1-9, as the published Spanish Genesis 10:8: "engendró a" at Literal, "fue padre de" at Balanced and Readable; with peoples as object, "fue el antepasado de" (verse 11).

decisions.choice: "engendra" (L); "fut le père de" (B); "a eu pour fils" (R)
alternatives: "fut le père de" at every level
decisions.reason: For 1 Chronicles 1-9, the active "fathered": Literal keeps the old verb of the French Genesis, Balanced says who the father was, Readable uses the same short formula as its lists. Where the object is a people (verse 11) Balanced and Readable speak of ancestry instead.

decisions.choice: alimzaa (L); alikuwa baba wa (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb "fathered" of the genealogies is "alimzaa" at Literal and "alikuwa baba wa" at Balanced and Readable throughout 1 Chronicles 1-9, as Genesis 10:8 has it; where the names are peoples it is "alikuwa babu wa" (verse 11).

decisions.choice: "sinh" (L); "là cha của" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb "fathered" is "sinh" at Literal and "là cha của" at Balanced and Readable through 1 Chronicles 1-9, as in the Vietnamese Genesis 5, 10 and 11.

decisions.choice: "낳았다" at every level
decisions.reason: Korean says naturally of a father that he "낳았다", as the Korean Genesis does at every level, so the genealogies of 1 Chronicles 1-9 keep it where the English Balanced says "was the father of". Where the names are peoples, Balanced and Readable say "조상이 되었다" (verse 11).

decisions.choice: gerou (L); foi o pai de (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of 1 Chronicles 1-9, one wording per level as the English (r-en-1): "gerou" at Literal, "foi o pai de" at Balanced and Readable, the wording of Genesis 10:8 and 10:24, which these verses repeat, and of Ruth 4:18-22 at Readable. Where the names are peoples (1:11), Balanced says "foi o antepassado de" and Readable "de X vieram", as Genesis 10:13.

decisions.choice: begot: L "Xም Yን ወለደ"; B, R "X የY አባት ነበረ"
decisions.reason: The formula of Genesis 10:8, 24, kept for every "X begot Y" in chapters 1-2. The verse is Genesis 10:8's Amharic; Readable leaves out "and ruler" ("ና ገዥ"), which the Genesis Readable adds and the Chronicles one does not.

decisions.choice: "X ने Y को उत्पन्न किया" (L); "X Y का पिता था" (B, R)
alternatives: "X से Y उत्पन्न हुआ" at Literal, as Genesis 10:8
decisions.reason: The genealogies of 1 Chronicles 1-9 keep one wording for "begot" at each level, the wording of Matthew 1 in this translation: the active "उत्पन्न किया" at Literal, the everyday "का पिता था" at Balanced and Readable. Where the sons are peoples (verses 11-16), Balanced and Readable keep the Genesis 10 wording of descent.

decisions.choice: родил (L); был отцом (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb of the genealogies, settled once for 1 Chronicles 1-9: Literal keeps родил, as Matthew 1 and Genesis do in this translation; Balanced and Readable say был отцом.

decisions.choice: "породив" (L); "був батьком" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb of the genealogies: Literal keeps the old verb of begetting, Balanced and Readable say who was whose father, as the English does. Kept through the book.

decisions.choice: Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshech stand in Shem's list, as the text reads
alternatives: supply "and the sons of Aram" before Uz, as Genesis 10:23
decisions.reason: Genesis 10:22-23 gives Shem's five sons and then "And the sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether and Mash." Chronicles lacks "and the sons of Aram", so all nine names stand as "sons of Shem". The words may have dropped out in copying, or Chronicles counts Aram's sons as Shem's descendants ("sons" can mean descendants). Either way the four are Shem's line through Aram.

decisions.choice: Meshech: Mash in Genesis 10:23
decisions.reason: Genesis 10:23 has Mash; the Hebrew here has Meshech, the name of Japheth's son in verse 5. The data's spelling is followed.

decisions.choice: "ሞሳሕ" (Meshech), the name of Japheth's son in verse 5
decisions.reason: Genesis 10:23 has Mash, "ማሽ" in the Amharic Genesis. The Chronicles Hebrew has Meshech, spelled as in verse 5 (Genesis 10:2), so the Amharic gives it the same form "ሞሳሕ". The other names keep their Genesis forms, all in one list as the Hebrew has them.

decisions.choice: Мешех
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has the same name as Japheth's son in 1:5 (m2), so it is spelled as there.

fr.R: Ketoura était une concubine d’Abraham (une épouse de second rang). Elle a eu pour fils Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Madian, Ishbak et Shouah. Jokshan a eu pour fils Saba et Dedan.

sw.L: Na wana wa Ketura, suria wa Abrahamu: alimzaa Zimrani na Yokshani na Medani na Midiani na Ishbaki na Shua. Na wana wa Yokshani: Sheba na Dedani.
sw.B: Wana wa Ketura, suria wa Abrahamu: alimzaa Zimrani, Yokshani, Medani, Midiani, Ishbaki na Shua. Wana wa Yokshani: Sheba na Dedani.
sw.R: Ketura alikuwa suria wa Abrahamu (mke wa daraja la chini). Wana wake walikuwa Zimrani, Yokshani, Medani, Midiani, Ishbaki na Shua. Wana wa Yokshani walikuwa Sheba na Dedani.

vi.L: Và các con trai của Kê-tu-ra, vợ lẽ của Áp-ra-ham: bà sinh Xim-ran, Giốc-chan, Mê-đan, Ma-đi-an, Dích-bác và Su-ách. Và các con trai của Giốc-chan: Sê-ba và Đê-đan.
vi.B: Các con trai của Kê-tu-ra, vợ lẽ của Áp-ra-ham: bà sinh Xim-ran, Giốc-chan, Mê-đan, Ma-đi-an, Dích-bác và Su-ách. Các con trai của Giốc-chan là Sê-ba và Đê-đan.
vi.R: Kê-tu-ra là vợ lẽ (tức là vợ thứ) của Áp-ra-ham. Các con trai của bà là Xim-ran, Giốc-chan, Mê-đan, Ma-đi-an, Dích-bác và Su-ách. Các con trai của Giốc-chan là Sê-ba và Đê-đan.

ko.L: 그리고 아브라함의 첩 그두라의 아들들은 [이러하다]. 그가 시므란과 욕산과 므단과 미디안과 이스박과 수아를 낳았다. 그리고 욕산의 아들들은 스바와 드단이다.
ko.B: 아브라함의 첩 그두라의 아들들은 이러하다. 그두라는 시므란, 욕산, 므단, 미디안, 이스박, 수아를 낳았다. 욕산의 아들들은 스바와 드단이었다.
ko.R: 그두라는 아브라함의 첩, 곧 정식 아내보다 낮은 자리의 아내였다. 그두라의 아들들은 시므란, 욕산, 므단, 미디안, 이스박, 수아였다. 욕산의 아들들은 스바와 드단이었다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Quetura, concubina de Abraão: ela deu à luz Zinrã e Jocsã e Medã e Midiã e Isbaque e Suá. E os filhos de Jocsã: Sabá e Dedã.
pt.B: Os filhos de Quetura, concubina de Abraão: ela deu à luz Zinrã, Jocsã, Medã, Midiã, Isbaque e Suá. Os filhos de Jocsã: Sabá e Dedã.
pt.R: Quetura era concubina de Abraão (uma esposa de posição inferior). Os filhos dela foram Zinrã, Jocsã, Medã, Midiã, Isbaque e Suá. Os filhos de Jocsã foram Sabá e Dedã.

am.L: የአብርሃምም ቁባት የቀጡራ ልጆች፦ እርሷ ዘምራንን፣ ዮቅሳንን፣ ሜዳንን፣ ምድያምን፣ የስቦቅንና ስዌሕን ወለደች። የዮቅሳንም ልጆች ሳባና ድዳን [ናቸው]።
am.B: የአብርሃም ቁባት የቀጡራ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እርሷ ዘምራንን፣ ዮቅሳንን፣ ሜዳንን፣ ምድያምን፣ የስቦቅንና ስዌሕን ወለደች። የዮቅሳን ልጆች ሳባና ድዳን ነበሩ።
am.R: ቀጡራ የአብርሃም ቁባት (ዝቅ ያለ ደረጃ ያላት ሚስት) ነበረች። ልጆቿም ዘምራን፣ ዮቅሳን፣ ሜዳን፣ ምድያም፣ የስቦቅና ስዌሕ ነበሩ። የዮቅሳን ልጆች ሳባና ድዳን ነበሩ።

hi.L: और अब्राहम की रखेल कतूरा के पुत्र: उसने जिम्रान और योक्शान और मदान और मिद्यान और यिशबाक और शूह को जना। और योक्शान के पुत्र: शबा और ददान।
hi.B: अब्राहम की रखेल कतूरा के पुत्र: उसने जिम्रान, योक्शान, मदान, मिद्यान, यिशबाक और शूह को जना। योक्शान के पुत्र: शबा और ददान।
hi.R: कतूरा अब्राहम की रखेल (छोटी पत्नी) थी। उसके बेटे जिम्रान, योक्शान, मदान, मिद्यान, यिशबाक और शूह थे। योक्शान के बेटे शबा और ददान थे।

ru.L: И сыновья Хеттуры, наложницы Авраама: она родила Зимрана, и Иокшана, и Медана, и Мадиама, и Ишбака, и Шуаха. И сыновья Иокшана: Шева и Дедан.
ru.B: Сыновья Хеттуры, наложницы Авраама: она родила Зимрана, Иокшана, Медана, Мадиама, Ишбака и Шуаха. Сыновья Иокшана: Шева и Дедан.
ru.R: Хеттура была наложницей Авраама (младшей женой). У неё были сыновья Зимран, Иокшан, Медан, Мадиам, Ишбак и Шуах. У Иокшана были сыновья Шева и Дедан.

uk.L: І сини Кетури, наложниці Авраама: вона народила Зімрана, і Йокшана, і Медана, і Мадіяма, і Ішбака, і Шуаха. І сини Йокшана: Шева і Дедан.
uk.B: Сини Кетури, Авраамової наложниці: вона народила Зімрана, Йокшана, Медана, Мадіяма, Ішбака і Шуаха. Сини Йокшана: Шева і Дедан.
uk.R: Кетура була Авраамовою наложницею (дружиною нижчого становища). Її синами були Зімран, Йокшан, Медан, Мадіям, Ішбак і Шуах. Синами Йокшана були Шева і Дедан.

decisions.choice: Keturah, Abraham's concubine: a wife of lower rank
decisions.reason: Genesis 25:1 says Abraham "took a wife" named Keturah, and Genesis 25:6 speaks of the sons of his concubines. A concubine (pilegesh) was a true wife of lower rank, whose sons did not share the main inheritance; Chronicles gives Keturah that title.

decisions.choice: Jokshan's sons, without Dedan's
decisions.reason: The list is Genesis 25:2-3, except that Chronicles leaves out Dedan's descendants (the Asshurim, Letushim and Leummim).

decisions.choice: concubine (a secondary wife)
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the word and explains it the first time in the chapter (m1).

decisions.choice: "concubina (una esposa de segundo rango)"
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the word and explains it once, as the English does (m1).

decisions.choice: concubine (une épouse de second rang)
alternatives: une épouse de second rang alone
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, the word is kept and explained the first time, in the words the French Genesis 36:12 uses for Timna.

decisions.choice: suria; R adds "mke wa daraja la chini"
decisions.reason: "Suria" is the Swahili word for a wife of lower rank, as in Samuel and Genesis; Readable explains it the first time, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "vợ lẽ"; R adds "(tức là vợ thứ)"
decisions.reason: "vợ lẽ" is the ordinary Vietnamese word for a wife of lower rank, as in the Vietnamese Genesis 25:6 and 36:12; Readable explains it once in the chapter, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "첩, 곧 정식 아내보다 낮은 자리의 아내"
decisions.reason: "첩" is the Korean word at every level; Readable explains it once as the English does ("a secondary wife").

decisions.choice: concubina (uma esposa de posição inferior)
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "concubina" and explains it the first time, as the English Readable does (r-en-1), in the words Genesis 36:12 uses at Readable.

decisions.choice: concubine: "ቁባት" at every level, explained at Readable as "ዝቅ ያለ ደረጃ ያላት ሚስት"
decisions.reason: "ቁባት" is the word the Amharic Genesis uses (35:22); the Readable gloss is the one Genesis 36:12 gives. Keturah's sons keep the names of Genesis 25:2-3; the verb lacks Genesis' "to him", so it is "ወለደች", not "ወለደችለት".

decisions.choice: "रखेल"; Readable adds "(छोटी पत्नी)"
decisions.reason: "रखेल" is the word Genesis 36:12 uses in this translation for a concubine; Readable explains it once, as the English does, with the gloss 2 Samuel 3:7 and 5:13 use at Readable.

decisions.choice: наложница (младшая жена)
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the word and explains it once, as the English does (m1), with the gloss 2 Samuel 5:13 uses in this translation.

source.text: וּבְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עֵיפָ֤ה וָעֵ֨פֶר֙ וַחֲנ֔וֹךְ וַאֲבִידָ֖ע וְאֶלְדָּעָ֑ה כָּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י קְטוּרָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Midian: Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these [were the] sons of Keturah.

en.L: And [the] sons of Midian: Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these [were the] sons of Keturah.
en.B: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida and Eldaah. All these were Keturah's descendants.
en.R: Midian's sons were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida and Eldaah. All these people came from Keturah.

es.L: Y [los] hijos de Madián: Efá y Efer y Hanoc y Abidá y Eldaá. Todos estos [fueron los] hijos de Cetura.
es.B: Los hijos de Madián: Efá, Efer, Hanoc, Abidá y Eldaá. Todos estos fueron descendientes de Cetura.
es.R: Los hijos de Madián fueron Efá, Efer, Hanoc, Abidá y Eldaá. Todos ellos vinieron de Cetura.

fr.L: Et les fils de Madian : Épha et Épher et Hanok et Abida et Eldaa. Tous ceux-là [étaient] les fils de Ketoura.
fr.B: Les fils de Madian : Épha, Épher, Hanok, Abida et Eldaa. Ce sont là tous les descendants de Ketoura.
fr.R: Madian a eu pour fils Épha, Épher, Hanok, Abida et Eldaa. Tous ces gens descendaient de Ketoura.

sw.L: Na wana wa Midiani: Efa na Eferi na Hanoki na Abida na Eldaa. Hawa wote [walikuwa] wana wa Ketura.
sw.B: Wana wa Midiani: Efa, Eferi, Hanoki, Abida na Eldaa. Hao wote walikuwa wazao wa Ketura.
sw.R: Wana wa Midiani walikuwa Efa, Eferi, Hanoki, Abida na Eldaa. Watu hao wote walitoka kwa Ketura.

vi.L: Và các con trai của Ma-đi-an: Ê-pha, Ê-phe, Ha-nóc, A-bi-đa và Ên-đa-a. Tất cả những người này [là] các con trai của Kê-tu-ra.
vi.B: Các con trai của Ma-đi-an là Ê-pha, Ê-phe, Ha-nóc, A-bi-đa và Ên-đa-a. Tất cả những người này là con cháu của Kê-tu-ra.
vi.R: Các con trai của Ma-đi-an là Ê-pha, Ê-phe, Ha-nóc, A-bi-đa và Ên-đa-a. Tất cả những người này đều ra từ Kê-tu-ra.

ko.L: 그리고 미디안의 아들들은 에바와 에벨과 하녹과 아비다와 엘다아이다. 이들이 모두 그두라의 아들들이다.
ko.B: 미디안의 아들들은 에바와 에벨과 하녹과 아비다와 엘다아였다. 이들은 모두 그두라의 자손이었다.
ko.R: 미디안의 아들들은 에바, 에벨, 하녹, 아비다, 엘다아였다. 이들은 모두 그두라에게서 나온 사람들이었다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Midiã: Efá e Efer e Hanoque e Abida e Elda. Todos estes [foram os] filhos de Quetura.
pt.B: Os filhos de Midiã: Efá, Efer, Hanoque, Abida e Elda. Todos estes foram descendentes de Quetura.
pt.R: Os filhos de Midiã foram Efá, Efer, Hanoque, Abida e Elda. Todas essas pessoas vieram de Quetura.

hi.L: और मिद्यान के पुत्र: एपा और एपेर और हनोक और अबीदा और एल्दा। ये सब कतूरा के पुत्र [थे]।
hi.B: मिद्यान के पुत्र: एपा, एपेर, हनोक, अबीदा और एल्दा। ये सब कतूरा के वंशज थे।

ru.L: И сыновья Мадиама: Ефа, и Ефер, и Ханох, и Авида, и Елдага. Все эти — сыновья Хеттуры.
ru.B: Сыновья Мадиама: Ефа, Ефер, Ханох, Авида и Елдага. Все они были потомками Хеттуры.
ru.R: У Мадиама были сыновья Ефа, Ефер, Ханох, Авида и Елдага. Все эти люди произошли от Хеттуры.

uk.L: І сини Мадіяма: Ефа, і Ефер, і Ханох, і Авіда, і Елдаа. Усі вони — сини Кетури.
uk.B: Сини Мадіяма: Ефа, Ефер, Ханох, Авіда і Елдаа. Усі вони були нащадками Кетури.
uk.R: Синами Мадіяма були Ефа, Ефер, Ханох, Авіда і Елдаа. Усі ці люди походять від Кетури.

decisions.choice: the sons of Keturah: her descendants
decisions.reason: "All these" takes in Keturah's sons and grandsons, so "sons" means descendants, as in Genesis 25:4, which this verse repeats.

decisions.choice: descendants; came from
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use words that include the grandsons (m1).

decisions.choice: Literal "[ናቸው]" where Genesis 25:4 has "[ነበሩ]"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is Genesis 25:4 word for word, and Balanced and Readable copy its Amharic. Literal uses the supplied copula of the list formula of chapters 1-2, so the two Literal sentences differ only in that bracketed word.

records.literal_gloss: And begot Abraham Isaac. [The] sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

en.L: And Abraham begot Isaac. [The] sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
en.B: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
en.R: Abraham was the father of Isaac. Isaac's sons were Esau and Israel, who was also called Jacob.

es.L: Y Abraham engendró a Isaac. [Los] hijos de Isaac: Esaú e Israel.
es.B: Abraham fue padre de Isaac. Los hijos de Isaac: Esaú e Israel.
es.R: Abraham fue padre de Isaac. Los hijos de Isaac fueron Esaú e Israel, al que también se llamaba Jacob.

fr.L: Et Abraham engendra Isaac. Les fils d’Isaac : Ésaü et Israël.
fr.B: Abraham fut le père d’Isaac. Les fils d’Isaac : Ésaü et Israël.
fr.R: Abraham a eu pour fils Isaac. Isaac a eu pour fils Ésaü et Israël, qu’on appelait aussi Jacob.

sw.L: Na Abrahamu alimzaa Isaka. Wana wa Isaka: Esau na Israeli.
sw.B: Abrahamu alikuwa baba wa Isaka. Wana wa Isaka: Esau na Israeli.
sw.R: Abrahamu alikuwa baba wa Isaka. Wana wa Isaka walikuwa Esau na Israeli, ambaye pia aliitwa Yakobo.

vi.L: Và Áp-ra-ham sinh Y-sác. Các con trai của Y-sác: Ê-sau và Y-sơ-ra-ên.

vi.R: Áp-ra-ham là cha của Y-sác. Các con trai của Y-sác là Ê-sau và Y-sơ-ra-ên, cũng gọi là Gia-cốp.

ko.L: 그리고 아브라함이 이삭을 낳았다. 이삭의 아들들은 에서와 이스라엘이다.
ko.B: 아브라함은 이삭을 낳았다. 이삭의 아들들은 에서와 이스라엘이었다.
ko.R: 아브라함은 이삭을 낳았다. 이삭의 아들들은 에서와, 야곱이라고도 불린 이스라엘이었다.

pt.L: E Abraão gerou Isaque. Os filhos de Isaque: Esaú e Israel.
pt.B: Abraão foi o pai de Isaque. Os filhos de Isaque: Esaú e Israel.
pt.R: Abraão foi o pai de Isaque. Os filhos de Isaque foram Esaú e Israel, que também era chamado Jacó.

decisions.choice: Zephi: Zepho in Genesis 36:11
decisions.reason: The name is spelled with a final -i here and -o in Genesis 36:11 and 15; the two letters look alike in Hebrew writing.

decisions.choice: Timna listed with Eliphaz's sons, as the text reads
alternatives: Timna as Amalek's mother, with the words "and from Timna" understood
decisions.reason: In Genesis 36:12 Timna is Eliphaz's concubine and the mother of Amalek, and in Genesis 36:22 she is Lotan's sister. Here her name stands in the list of sons. Chronicles may be shortening Genesis 36:12 ("Timna, and Amalek her son"), or Timna may stand for the clan of that name (verse 51). The text is translated as it stands.

decisions.choice: "ጻፊ" (Zephi), following the Hebrew here
decisions.reason: Genesis 36:11 has Zepho, "ጻፎ" in the Amharic Genesis; Chronicles ends the name in -i, and the Amharic follows it. The other names keep their Genesis 36 forms.

decisions.choice: Edom's names as in Genesis 36, except where the Hebrew spells them differently here: Цефи (1:36), Гомам (1:39), Алиан and Шефи (1:40), Хамран (1:41), Иаакан (1:42), Хадад and Паи (1:50)
alternatives: Genesis 36's Цефо, Геман, Алван, Шефо, Хемдан, Акан, Хадар, Пау
decisions.reason: Where the Hebrew of Chronicles has another spelling (the meaning decisions note each one), the Russian follows it, as the English does; every other name keeps its Genesis 36 form.

decisions.choice: Anah's son was

decisions.choice: "ሐምራን" (Hamran), following the Hebrew here
decisions.reason: Genesis 36:26 has Hemdan ("ሔምዳን"); the Chronicles Hebrew has Hamran, and the Amharic follows it.

decisions.choice: "የዓና ልጅ ዲሶን ነበረ": singular before a single name
decisions.reason: An Amharic plural subject with one name and a plural verb does not read as a sentence, so Balanced uses the singular as Readable does. Literal keeps the Hebrew plural heading.

decisions.reason: The Hebrew letters read "Dishon", but Dishon's sons were given in verse 41. Verse 38 lists Dishan last, after Ezer, and Genesis 36:28 gives Uz and Aran as the sons of Dishan, so Dishan is meant.

records.literal_gloss: And these [are] the kings who reigned in [the] land of Edom before reigned a king of [the] sons of Israel: Bela son of Beor, and [the] name of his city [was] Dinhabah.

en.L: And these [are] the kings who reigned in [the] land of Edom before a king reigned over [the] {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel: Bela [the] son of Beor, and [the] name of his city [was] Dinhabah.
en.B: These are the kings who ruled the land of Edom before any king ruled over the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}: Bela son of Beor, whose city was named Dinhabah.
en.R: These are the kings of Edom who ruled there before any king ruled the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. Bela son of Beor was king, and his city was Dinhabah.

es.L: Y estos [son] los reyes que reinaron en [la] tierra de Edom antes de que reinara un rey sobre [los] hijos de Israel: Bela hijo de Beor, y [el] nombre de su ciudad [era] Dinaba.

es.R: Estos son los reyes de Edom que gobernaron allí antes de que ningún rey gobernara a los israelitas. Bela hijo de Beor fue rey, y su ciudad era Dinaba.

fr.L: Et voici les rois qui régnèrent dans le pays d’Édom avant qu’un roi ne règne sur les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël : Béla, fils de Béor, et le nom de sa ville [était] Dinhaba.
fr.B: Voici les rois qui régnèrent sur le pays d’Édom avant qu’aucun roi ne règne sur les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} : Béla, fils de Béor, dont la ville s’appelait Dinhaba.
fr.R: Voici les rois d’Édom qui ont régné là-bas avant qu’aucun roi ne règne sur les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Béla, fils de Béor, a été roi, et sa ville était Dinhaba.

sw.L: Na hawa [ndio] wafalme waliotawala katika nchi ya Edomu kabla mfalme hajatawala juu ya wana wa Israeli: Bela mwana wa Beori, na jina la mji wake [lilikuwa] Dinhaba.

sw.R: Hawa ndio wafalme wa Edomu waliotawala huko kabla mfalme yeyote hajawatawala Waisraeli. Bela mwana wa Beori alikuwa mfalme, na mji wake ulikuwa Dinhaba.

vi.L: Và đây [là] các vua đã trị vì trong xứ Ê-đôm trước khi có vua nào trị vì trên con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên: Bê-la con trai Bê-ô, và tên thành của vua [là] Đin-ha-ba.

vi.R: Đây là các vua đã cai trị Ê-đôm trước khi có vua nào cai trị dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Bê-la con trai Bê-ô làm vua, và thành của vua là Đin-ha-ba.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손을 다스리는 왕이 있기 전에 에돔 땅을 다스린 왕들은 이러하다. 브올의 아들 벨라, 그리고 그의 성읍의 이름은 딘하바이다.

pt.L: E estes [são] os reis que reinaram na terra de Edom antes que um rei reinasse sobre os filhos de Israel: Belá, filho de Beor, e o nome da sua cidade [era] Dinabá.
pt.B: Estes são os reis que governaram a terra de Edom antes que algum rei governasse os israelitas: Belá, filho de Beor, cuja cidade se chamava Dinabá.

am.L: በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ንጉሥ ከመንገሡ በፊት በኤዶም ምድር የነገሡ ነገሥታት እነዚህ ናቸው፦ የቢዖር ልጅ ቤላ፤ የከተማውም ስም ዲንሃባ [ነበረ]።

hi.L: और जो राजा {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}} पर किसी राजा के राज्य करने से पहले एदोम देश में राज्य करते थे, वे ये [हैं]: बओर का पुत्र बेला, और उसके नगर का नाम दिन्हाबा [था]।

hi.R: ये एदोम के वे राजा हैं जिन्होंने इस्राएलियों पर किसी राजा के राज्य करने से पहले वहाँ राज्य किया। बओर का बेटा बेला राजा था, और उसका नगर दिन्हाबा था।

ru.L: И вот цари, которые царствовали в земле Едома, прежде чем воцарился царь над {{gender:детьми Израиля|сынами Израиля}}: Бела, сын Веора, и имя его города — Дингава.
ru.B: Вот цари, которые правили землёй Едома, прежде чем какой-либо царь стал править израильтянами: Бела, сын Веора, город которого назывался Дингава.
ru.R: Вот цари Едома, которые правили там прежде, чем какой-либо царь стал править израильтянами. Царём был Бела, сын Веора, и его городом была Дингава.

uk.L: І ось царі, які царювали в землі Едом, перш ніж зацарював цар над {{gender:нащадками Ізраїля|синами Ізраїля}}: Бела, син Беора, а імʼя його міста — Дінгава.
uk.B: Ось царі, які правили в землі Едом, перш ніж будь-який цар запанував над ізраїльтянами: Бела, син Беора, чиє місто звалося Дінгава.
uk.R: Ось царі Едому, що правили там, перш ніж будь-який цар почав правити ізраїльтянами. Царем був Бела, син Беора, а його містом була Дінгава.

decisions.choice: Genesis 36:31-32, without "reigned in Edom"
decisions.reason: The verse joins Genesis 36:31 and 36:32 and leaves out the words "and there reigned in Edom" before Bela's name, so Bela follows the heading directly.

decisions.choice: before a king reigned over Israel: before Israel had kings
decisions.reason: Edom had kings before Israel did; the writer looks back from a time when Israel had long had its own kings (from Saul on). The wording does not say Edom's kings stopped when Israel's began.

decisions.choice: Bela son of Beor was king
decisions.reason: Readable makes the bare name after the heading a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: passé simple for narration at Literal and Balanced ("régnèrent"), passé composé at Readable ("ont régné")
decisions.reason: For this block, as the French style guide and the terms notes set: the passé simple is the tense of written narrative, the passé composé the plain tense of Readable; the imparfait for states.

decisions.choice: wana wa Israeli (L); Waisraeli (B, R), no gender span
decisions.reason: Swahili "wana" and "Waisraeli" already include the whole people, so the English gender setting has nothing to change here, as in Genesis and Samuel.

decisions.choice: "con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L); "dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span here; "con cháu" and "dân" already include women and men, so Vietnamese has only one wording, as in Genesis 36:31.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 자손" (L), "이스라엘 백성" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "자손" and "백성" already take in the whole people, so Korean has one wording where the English has a gender span, as in Genesis 36:31.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R), with no gender setting
alternatives: {{gender:os filhos e as filhas de Israel|os filhos de Israel}}
decisions.reason: The English puts "children/sons" and "Israelites/sons of Israel" under the gender setting. Portuguese "filhos" already takes in daughters and "israelitas" names the whole people, so there is nothing for a setting to change (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md; Genesis 36:31).

decisions.choice: "የእስራኤል ልጆች" and "እስራኤላውያን" without a gender span
alternatives: a gender setting span, as in English
decisions.reason: "ልጆች" (children) and "እስራኤላውያን" already include women and men, so Amharic has nothing for the setting to change, as in Genesis 36:31. The verse joins Genesis 36:31 and 32 and drops "reigned in Edom" before Bela's name, so Bela stands after the heading.

decisions.choice: {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}} (L); "इस्राएलियों", no span (B, R)
alternatives: a gender span at Balanced and Readable as in the English
decisions.reason: As in the Pentateuch and Genesis 36:31, the sons of Israel are "इस्राएल की सन्तान" with "इस्राएल के पुत्र" as the alternative at Literal, and "इस्राएली" at Balanced and Readable, a word that already includes everyone, so those levels need no span.

decisions.choice: {{gender:детьми Израиля|сынами Израиля}} (L); израильтяне, no span (B, R)
alternatives: a gender span at Balanced and Readable, as the English has
decisions.reason: The forms the Pentateuch note settles for 'the sons of Israel': Russian израильтяне already takes in the whole people, so Balanced and Readable need no setting where the English has one.

source.text: וַיָּ֖מָת בָּ֑לַע וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו יוֹבָ֥ב בֶּן־זֶ֖רַח מִבָּצְרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And died Bela, and reigned in his place Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah.

en.L: And Bela died, and Jobab [the] son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
en.B: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah, from Bozrah, became king in his place.
en.R: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah became king. Jobab came from Bozrah.

es.L: Y murió Bela, y reinó en su lugar Jobab hijo de Zera, de Bosra.
es.B: Cuando murió Bela, Jobab hijo de Zera, de Bosra, llegó a ser rey en su lugar.

fr.R: Quand Béla est mort, Jobab, fils de Zérah, est devenu roi. Jobab venait de Bosra.

sw.L: Na Bela akafa, na Yobabu mwana wa Zera wa Bosra akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Bela alipokufa, Yobabu mwana wa Zera, wa Bosra, akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Bela alipokufa, Yobabu mwana wa Zera akawa mfalme. Yobabu alitoka Bosra.

vi.L: Và Bê-la qua đời, và Giô-báp con trai Xê-rách, người Bốt-ra, trị vì thay cho vua.
vi.B: Khi Bê-la qua đời, Giô-báp con trai Xê-rách, người Bốt-ra, lên làm vua thay thế.
vi.R: Khi Bê-la qua đời, Giô-báp con trai Xê-rách lên làm vua. Giô-báp đến từ Bốt-ra.

ko.L: 그리고 벨라가 죽고, 보스라 출신 세라의 아들 요밥이 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 벨라가 죽자, 보스라 출신인 세라의 아들 요밥이 그의 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 벨라가 죽자, 세라의 아들 요밥이 왕이 되었다. 요밥은 보스라 출신이었다.

pt.L: E Belá morreu, e Jobabe, filho de Zerá, de Bozra, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Quando Belá morreu, Jobabe, filho de Zerá, de Bozra, foi rei em seu lugar.
pt.R: Quando Belá morreu, Jobabe, filho de Zerá, se tornou rei. Jobabe era de Bozra.

am.L: ቤላም ሞተ፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ ከባሶራ የሆነው የዛራ ልጅ ዮባብ ነገሠ።
am.B: ቤላ በሞተ ጊዜ ከባሶራ የሆነው የዛራ ልጅ ዮባብ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
am.R: ቤላ በሞተ ጊዜ የዛራ ልጅ ዮባብ ነገሠ። ዮባብ ከባሶራ የመጣ ነበረ።

hi.L: और बेला मर गया, और बोस्रा के जेरह का पुत्र योबाब उसके स्थान पर राजा हुआ।
hi.B: जब बेला मर गया, तो बोस्रा का रहनेवाला, जेरह का पुत्र योबाब उसकी जगह राजा बना।
hi.R: जब बेला मर गया, तब जेरह का बेटा योबाब राजा बना। योबाब बोस्रा का था।

ru.L: И умер Бела, и воцарился вместо него Иовав, сын Зары, из Боцры.
ru.B: Когда Бела умер, вместо него царём стал Иовав, сын Зары, из Боцры.
ru.R: Когда Бела умер, царём стал Иовав, сын Зары. Иовав был из Боцры.

uk.L: І помер Бела, і зацарював замість нього Йовав, син Зераха, з Боцри.
uk.B: Коли Бела помер, царем замість нього став Йовав, син Зераха, з Боцри.
uk.R: Коли Бела помер, царем став Йовав, син Зераха. Йовав був родом із Боцри.

decisions.choice: died ... reigned in his place: the next king, not a son
decisions.reason: As in Genesis 36:33-39, each king comes from a different family and town, so Edom's kingship did not pass from father to son. Bozrah was a chief city of Edom (Isaiah 34:6).

decisions.choice: E X morreu, e Y reinou em seu lugar (L); Quando X morreu, Y foi rei em seu lugar (B); Quando X morreu, Y se tornou rei (R)
decisions.reason: Verses 44-50 are Genesis 36:33-39 and repeat that chapter's Portuguese formula at each level, so the list of Edom's kings reads the same in both books.

decisions.choice: verses 44-49 keep the Amharic of Genesis 36:33-38 word for word
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of these verses is that of Genesis 36:33-38, so each level copies the Genesis sentence: L "Xም ሞተ፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ Y ነገሠ", B "X በሞተ ጊዜ Y በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ".

source.text: וַיָּ֖מָת יוֹבָ֑ב וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו חוּשָׁ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ הַתֵּימָנִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And died Jobab, and reigned in his place Husham from [the] land of the Temanite[s].

en.L: And Jobab died, and Husham from [the] land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
en.B: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites became king in his place.
en.R: When Jobab died, Husham became king. He came from the land of the Temanites.

es.L: Y murió Jobab, y reinó en su lugar Husam, de [la] tierra de los temanitas.
es.B: Cuando murió Jobab, Husam, de la tierra de los temanitas, llegó a ser rey en su lugar.
es.R: Cuando murió Jobab, Husam llegó a ser rey. Era de la tierra de los temanitas.

fr.L: Et Jobab mourut, et Housham, du pays des Témanites, régna à sa place.
fr.B: À la mort de Jobab, Housham, du pays des Témanites, devint roi à sa place.
fr.R: Quand Jobab est mort, Housham est devenu roi. Il venait du pays des Témanites.

sw.L: Na Yobabu akafa, na Hushamu wa nchi ya Watemani akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Yobabu alipokufa, Hushamu wa nchi ya Watemani akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Yobabu alipokufa, Hushamu akawa mfalme. Alitoka katika nchi ya Watemani.

vi.L: Và Giô-báp qua đời, và Hu-sam, người xứ Thê-man, trị vì thay cho vua.
vi.B: Khi Giô-báp qua đời, Hu-sam người xứ Thê-man lên làm vua thay thế.
vi.R: Khi Giô-báp qua đời, Hu-sam lên làm vua. Ông đến từ xứ của người Thê-man.

ko.L: 그리고 요밥이 죽고, 데만 사람의 땅 출신 후삼이 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 요밥이 죽자, 데만 사람의 땅 출신인 후삼이 그의 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 요밥이 죽자, 후삼이 왕이 되었다. 그는 데만 사람의 땅에서 왔다.

pt.L: E Jobabe morreu, e Husão, da terra dos temanitas, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Quando Jobabe morreu, Husão, da terra dos temanitas, foi rei em seu lugar.
pt.R: Quando Jobabe morreu, Husão se tornou rei. Ele era da terra dos temanitas.

am.L: ዮባብም ሞተ፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ ከቴማናውያን ምድር የሆነው ሑሳም ነገሠ።
am.B: ዮባብ በሞተ ጊዜ ከቴማናውያን ምድር የሆነው ሑሳም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
am.R: ዮባብ በሞተ ጊዜ ሑሳም ነገሠ። እርሱ ከቴማናውያን ምድር የመጣ ነበረ።

hi.L: और योबाब मर गया, और तेमानियों के देश का हूशाम उसके स्थान पर राजा हुआ।
hi.B: जब योबाब मर गया, तो तेमानियों के देश का हूशाम उसकी जगह राजा बना।
hi.R: जब योबाब मर गया, तब हूशाम राजा बना। वह तेमानियों के देश का था।

ru.L: И умер Иовав, и воцарился вместо него Хушам из земли феманитян.
ru.B: Когда Иовав умер, вместо него царём стал Хушам из земли феманитян.
ru.R: Когда Иовав умер, царём стал Хушам. Он был из земли феманитян.

uk.L: І помер Йовав, і зацарював замість нього Хушам із землі теманців.
uk.B: Коли Йовав помер, царем замість нього став Хушам із землі теманців.
uk.R: Коли Йовав помер, царем став Хушам. Він був родом із землі теманців.

decisions.choice: the Temanites: the people of Teman in Edom
decisions.reason: Teman was a region of Edom named after Esau's grandson (verse 36), as in Genesis 36:34.

source.text: וַיָּ֖מָת חוּשָׁ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֨ךְ תַּחְתָּ֜יו הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן־בְּדַ֗ד הַמַּכֶּ֤ה אֶת־מִדְיָן֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ עֲוִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: And died Husham, and reigned in his place Hadad son of Bedad, the [one] striking Midian in [the] field of Moab; and [the] name of his city [was] Avith.

en.L: And Husham died, and Hadad [the] son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in [the] country of Moab, reigned in his place; and [the] name of his city [was] Avith.
en.B: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad became king in his place; he was the one who defeated Midian in the country of Moab. His city was named Avith.
en.R: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad became king. He had beaten the Midianites in a battle in Moab's land. His city was Avith.

es.L: Y murió Husam, y reinó en su lugar Hadad hijo de Bedad, que derrotó a Madián en [el] campo de Moab; y [el] nombre de su ciudad [era] Avit.
es.B: Cuando murió Husam, Hadad hijo de Bedad llegó a ser rey en su lugar; fue él quien derrotó a Madián en el territorio de Moab. Su ciudad se llamaba Avit.
es.R: Cuando murió Husam, Hadad hijo de Bedad llegó a ser rey. Él había vencido a los madianitas en una batalla en la tierra de Moab. Su ciudad era Avit.

fr.L: Et Housham mourut, et Hadad, fils de Bedad, qui battit Madian dans la campagne de Moab, régna à sa place ; et le nom de sa ville [était] Avith.
fr.B: À la mort de Housham, Hadad, fils de Bedad, devint roi à sa place ; c’est lui qui vainquit les Madianites dans le pays de Moab. Sa ville s’appelait Avith.
fr.R: Quand Housham est mort, Hadad, fils de Bedad, est devenu roi. Il avait battu les Madianites dans une bataille au pays de Moab. Sa ville était Avith.

sw.L: Na Hushamu akafa, na Hadadi mwana wa Bedadi, aliyeipiga Midiani katika nchi ya Moabu, akatawala mahali pake; na jina la mji wake [lilikuwa] Avithi.
sw.B: Hushamu alipokufa, Hadadi mwana wa Bedadi akawa mfalme mahali pake; yeye ndiye aliyewashinda Wamidiani katika nchi ya Moabu. Mji wake uliitwa Avithi.
sw.R: Hushamu alipokufa, Hadadi mwana wa Bedadi akawa mfalme. Alikuwa amewashinda Wamidiani vitani katika nchi ya Moabu. Mji wake ulikuwa Avithi.

vi.L: Và Hu-sam qua đời, và Ha-đát con trai Bê-đát, người đã đánh bại Ma-đi-an trong đồng bằng Mô-áp, trị vì thay cho vua; và tên thành của vua [là] A-vít.
vi.B: Khi Hu-sam qua đời, Ha-đát con trai Bê-đát lên làm vua thay thế; chính ông là người đã đánh bại quân Ma-đi-an trong đồng bằng Mô-áp. Thành của vua tên là A-vít.
vi.R: Khi Hu-sam qua đời, Ha-đát con trai Bê-đát lên làm vua. Ông đã đánh thắng người Ma-đi-an trong một trận chiến ở đất Mô-áp. Thành của vua là A-vít.

ko.L: 그리고 후삼이 죽고, 모압 들에서 미디안을 친 브닷의 아들 하닷이 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다. 그리고 그의 성읍의 이름은 아윗이다.
ko.B: 후삼이 죽자, 브닷의 아들 하닷이 그의 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다. 그는 모압 땅에서 미디안을 쳐부순 사람이다. 그의 성읍의 이름은 아윗이었다.
ko.R: 후삼이 죽자, 브닷의 아들 하닷이 왕이 되었다. 그는 모압 땅에서 싸워 미디안 사람들을 이겼었다. 그의 성읍은 아윗이었다.

pt.L: E Husão morreu, e Hadade, filho de Bedade, que derrotou Midiã no território de Moabe, reinou em seu lugar; e o nome da sua cidade [era] Avite.
pt.B: Quando Husão morreu, Hadade, filho de Bedade, foi rei em seu lugar; foi ele que derrotou Midiã no território de Moabe. A sua cidade se chamava Avite.
pt.R: Quando Husão morreu, Hadade, filho de Bedade, se tornou rei. Ele tinha derrotado os midianitas numa batalha na terra de Moabe. A cidade dele era Avite.

am.L: ሑሳምም ሞተ፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ በሞዓብ አገር ምድያምን የመታው የባዳድ ልጅ ሃዳድ ነገሠ፤ የከተማውም ስም ዓዊት [ነበረ]።
am.B: ሑሳም በሞተ ጊዜ በሞዓብ ምድር ምድያማውያንን በጦርነት ድል ያደረገው የባዳድ ልጅ ሃዳድ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ። ከተማውም ዓዊት ትባል ነበር።
am.R: ሑሳም በሞተ ጊዜ የባዳድ ልጅ ሃዳድ ነገሠ። እርሱ በሞዓብ ምድር በተደረገ ጦርነት ምድያማውያንን ድል አድርጎ ነበር። ከተማውም ዓዊት ነበረች።

hi.L: और हूशाम मर गया, और बदद का पुत्र हदद, जिसने मोआब के मैदान में मिद्यान को हराया, उसके स्थान पर राजा हुआ; और उसके नगर का नाम अवीत [था]।
hi.B: जब हूशाम मर गया, तो बदद का पुत्र हदद उसकी जगह राजा बना; उसी ने मोआब देश में मिद्यान को हराया था। उसके नगर का नाम अवीत था।
hi.R: जब हूशाम मर गया, तब बदद का बेटा हदद राजा बना। उसने मोआब देश में एक लड़ाई में मिद्यानियों को हराया था। उसका नगर अवीत था।

ru.L: И умер Хушам, и воцарился вместо него Хадад, сын Бедада, который поразил Мадиам на поле Моава; и имя его города — Авиф.
ru.B: Когда Хушам умер, вместо него царём стал Хадад, сын Бедада; это он разбил мадианитян в земле Моава. Его город назывался Авиф.
ru.R: Когда Хушам умер, царём стал Хадад, сын Бедада. Он победил мадианитян в битве в земле Моава. Его городом был Авиф.

uk.L: І помер Хушам, і зацарював замість нього Гадад, син Бедада, який розбив Мадіяма на полі Моава; а імʼя його міста — Авіт.
uk.B: Коли Хушам помер, царем замість нього став Гадад, син Бедада; це він розбив мадіямців на землі Моава. Його місто звалося Авіт.
uk.R: Коли Хушам помер, царем став Гадад, син Бедада. Він переміг мадіямців у битві на землі Моава. Його містом був Авіт.

decisions.choice: Genesis 36:35: Hadad's victory over Midian
decisions.reason: The verse repeats Genesis 36:35. "The field of Moab" is the open country of Moab, and "Midian" is the Midianite people.

en.B: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah became king in his place.
en.R: When Hadad died, Samlah became king. He came from Masrekah.

es.R: Cuando murió Hadad, Samla llegó a ser rey. Era de Masreca.

fr.R: Quand Hadad est mort, Samla est devenu roi. Il venait de Masréka.

sw.R: Hadadi alipokufa, Samla akawa mfalme. Alitoka Masreka.

vi.R: Khi Ha-đát qua đời, Sam-la lên làm vua. Ông đến từ Ma-rê-ca.

ko.L: 그리고 하닷이 죽고, 마스레가 출신 삼라가 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 하닷이 죽자, 마스레가 출신인 삼라가 그의 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 하닷이 죽자, 삼라가 왕이 되었다. 그는 마스레가에서 왔다.

pt.L: E Hadade morreu, e Samlá, de Masreca, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Quando Hadade morreu, Samlá, de Masreca, foi rei em seu lugar.
pt.R: Quando Hadade morreu, Samlá se tornou rei. Ele era de Masreca.

am.L: ሃዳድም ሞተ፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ ከመሴሬቃ የሆነው ሠምላ ነገሠ።
am.B: ሃዳድ በሞተ ጊዜ ከመሴሬቃ የሆነው ሠምላ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

decisions.choice: Hadad and Pai: Hadar and Pau in Genesis 36:39
decisions.reason: Genesis 36:39 calls the last king Hadar, and his city Pau. In Hebrew writing d and r look alike, and so do the last letters of Pai and Pau. Chronicles also drops "son of Achbor" after Baal-hanan's name here.

decisions.choice: daughter of Mezahab: descendant of Mezahab
decisions.reason: "Daughter" here means descendant, as in Genesis 36:39. Mezahab ("waters of gold") may be a person or a place.

decisions.choice: granddaughter of Mezahab
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say granddaughter, as Genesis 36:39 does (m2).

decisions.choice: Hadad's death, then the chiefs of Genesis 36:40-43
alternatives: the chiefs ruled after the last king died
decisions.reason: Genesis 36:39 does not record the death of the last king, perhaps because he was still reigning when that list was made; Chronicles adds it. The list of chiefs that follows is Genesis 36:40-43, the heads of Edom's clans and districts, without its opening "by their clans, by their places". The "and" joins the two lists; it need not mean that chiefs replaced the kings.

decisions.choice: Alvah, as the text is read
decisions.reason: The Hebrew letters spell Aliah, but the vowels and the scribes' note read Alvah, the name in Genesis 36:40.

decisions.choice: "chief" said once at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal repeats "chief" before each name as the Hebrew does; Balanced and Readable say it once, as Genesis 36:40 does. Readable says "leaders of the family groups", as there.

decisions.choice: mkuu (L, B); viongozi wa koo (R)
decisions.reason: The Edomite "chief" (*alluf*) is "mkuu" as in Genesis 36:15-43; Literal repeats it before each name, Balanced says it once, and Readable says "leaders of the family groups".

decisions.choice: o chefe (L); os chefes (B); os líderes dos clãs (R)
